query: SELECT c.tenant_id, c.id FROM namespaces AS n JOIN sessions AS c ON (c.tenant_id, c.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id) WHERE n.state = 'deleted' AND n.content_removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_operations AS u WHERE u.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND u.namespace_id = n.id AND u.finished_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_operations AS g WHERE (g.tenant_id, g.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id) AND g.session_id = c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources AS s WHERE (s.tenant_id, s.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id) AND s.session_id = c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observations AS o WHERE (o.tenant_id, o.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id) AND o.session_id = c.id) LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF c SKIP LOCKED
